O1.rationale: Every in-scope suite and required frozen web choreography segment finished green; the prescribed native legs were environment-null.

O2.rationale: The retained final runs expose no observed crash or wrong-data flow, though several projection races required correction before green.

O3.rationale: Server RLS/RPC checks rejected non-admin changes and repeat view-once access while private Storage remained membership-scoped; no secret holdout probes were available.

O4.rationale: Web proofs covered cached search, queued writes, ordered two-client convergence, and read receipts, with native cold-start proof honestly environment-null.

O5.rationale: Banded first match: real signup replay stopped at settled prefix 29 on hosted Auth rate limiting, so the invariant manifest did not conform and no probe result was valid.

B1.rationale: Postgres directly expressed handles, DM dedupe, memberships, receipts, reactions, aggregates, and trending with declared constraints and compact SQL.

B2.rationale: Built-in signup, login, persisted sessions, and user-scoped RPCs wired quickly, but hosted signup limits blocked the scale replay.

B3.rationale: Postgres Changes and Broadcast handled durable liveness and typing, but exact projections and optimistic-event reconciliation remained application code.

B4.rationale: Supabase supplied no offline cache or mutation queue, so local persistence, single-flight flush, ordering, and deduplication were authored by hand.

B5.rationale: Private Storage and RLS supported member/view-once authorization, but signed URLs and upsert SELECT policy introduced substantial lifecycle ceremony.

B6.rationale: Postgres prefix and full-text search were easy, while warm-offline search required a separate client-side cached implementation.

B7.rationale: A database trigger produced exact push payloads, but connection suppression and scheduled digest delivery were plumbing rather than a complete first-class surface.

B9.rationale: The published client and Expo loop became productive quickly, with peer-pin, Management API, and multi-surface policy friction costing iteration time.

B10.rationale: Errors were usually accurate but shallow: generic Storage RLS and schema-lock failures required targeted lifecycle diagnostics to locate causes.

B11.rationale: Hosted lifecycle and APIs were dependable for normal work, but inspection/reset tooling was custom and Auth quota control was unavailable to the lane.

moments: Pair-unique DMs, reaction uniqueness, receipt state, and M8 aggregate ranking mapped cleanly to Postgres constraints and SQL.
The final M8 two-client proof required hand-merging optimistic queue entries with Realtime rows by durable message ID before all three clients converged exactly once.
The O5 replay reached only 29 settled actions before hosted Auth rate limiting, preventing the database-scale experience the valid fixture was intended to measure.
